q1: SELECT b.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT f.drinker) AS num_drinker, AVG(s.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f1.drinker FROM frequents AS f1 WHERE f1.bar = b.name ORDER BY f1.times_a_week DESC, f1.drinker ASC LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar AS b LEFT JOIN frequents AS f ON b.name = f.bar LEFT JOIN serves AS s ON b.name = s.bar GROUP BY b.name ORDER BY num_drinker DESC, b.name ASC
q2: SELECT bar.name AS bar, COUNT(DISTINCT frequents.drinker) AS total_num_drinker, AVG(serves.price) AS avg_price, (SELECT f2.drinker FROM frequents AS f2 WHERE f2.bar = bar.name GROUP BY f2.drinker ORDER BY MAX(f2.times_a_week), f2.drinker LIMIT 1) AS most_reg_drinker FROM bar, frequents, serves WHERE bar.name = frequents.bar AND bar.name = serves.bar GROUP BY bar.name ORDER BY total_num_drinker DESC, bar.name
